title: HW02 Part B
desc: LangChain + Ollama: ask Mistral the time, fix it with a tool

cells.s:
# Connect LangChain to the local Mistral model through Ollama

llm = OllamaLLM(model="mistral")

# Ask Mistral a question

response = llm.invoke("What is the current time?")

cells.o: I don't have real-time capabilities, so I can't tell you the current time. However, I can help you understand how to check the current time on various devices. On a computer, you can usually find the current time in the system tray, and on a mobile device, it's typically visible on the home screen. If you're looking for the time in a specific time zone, you can often find this information online or through weather apps.
